source.sourceProvenance: Verified Nov 17 device CarParams and Nov 18 private parked/drive R-log reviews

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Matched onroad steering request, lateral acceleration, EPS motor feedback, curvature and speed across independent clean curves; parameter identified with independent held-out routes
candidateParameters.guard: No change to live controller or Panda limits before independent offline error and robustness validation

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Independent route segments with left/right small-curvature steering, corrected road bank and driver torque intervention, separated from EPS rate/torque limiting
candidateParameters.guard: Do not increase commanded steering torque or reduce override protection

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Causal, actual installed controller timestamp reconstruction excluding ambiguous control phase, torque clipping and driver intervention; multiple independent routes
candidateParameters.guard: Learned 0.32 seconds is NOT a validated replacement parameter

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Complete model laneChangeStarting, laneChangeFinishing and recenter episodes, verified physical lateral clearance and driver intervention, held-out replay
candidateParameters.guard: Do not infer lateral acceleration or jerk from steering wheel rate alone

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Sustained validated lead observations with known no driver pedals and no stale model source across multiple speed bands and independent runs
candidateParameters.guard: Factory ACC is longitudinal authority; never write an assumed distance or tighter follow target

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: Exact installed controller source/firmware, independently validated Panda safety checks and complete control-phase replay
candidateParameters.guard: No changes to torque ceiling, EPS-relative clipping, rate limits, safety configuration or override

candidateParameters.evidenceNeeded: OEM-approved Comma LKAS low-speed authorization on exact EPS firmware; factory auto-park is a distinct OEM mode
candidateParameters.guard: No firmware spoofing, Parking Assist CAN replay, ECU bypass or enabling an unsupported zero-speed LKAS mode
